P06-013 medium (MT 28:25-28:26), decision keep: the cited two-verse precedent at MT 33:21-22 is described as messenger onset plus recognition close plus parashah mark; only the mark is there. MT 33:21 is a dated notice with the fugitive's report and MT 33:22 is hand-of-YHWH/mouth-opening narrative. The row's own evidence at MT 28:25/28:26 is independently sound, so the seam holds.

P06-010 low (MT 28:1-28:10), decision keep: MT 28:10 reads the short spoken clause with no divine name (4 verses in the book), not the fuller clause that reads the divine name (14 verses, standing at MT 26:14); the family label overstates the close.
